title: How This Year's Super El Niño Will Worsen Global Hunger
summary: A monster El Niño is nearing its peak, deepening drought in many parts of the world. Coming as countries slash foreign aid and war chokes supplies of energy and fertilizer, the climate phenomenon could leave millions more people in vulnerable countries without enough to eat.

The world is now in the grip of a super El Niño: a Godzilla-sized version of a natural climate phenomenon that has already shriveled rivers, upended aquaculture, and flattened crops with drought. But the global organizations that keep an eye on food security are warning of even tougher times ahead.
summary_zh: 巨大的厄爾尼諾現象正接近頂峰，加劇了世界許多地區的乾旱。隨著各國削減對外援助以及戰爭阻礙能源和化肥供應，氣候現象可能導致脆弱國家的數百萬人吃不飽。
世界現在正遭受超級厄爾尼諾現象的影響：這是一種哥吉拉大小的自然氣候現象，已經導致河流乾涸、水產養殖業崩潰、農作物因乾旱而被夷為平地。但關注糧食安全的全球組織警告稱，未來的日子將更加艱難。
